onboarding.title: Situational diagnostic
onboarding.subtitle: Pick what fits you — the co-pilot calibrates your performance spectrum.
onboarding.cardsHint: Each choice adjusts Structure, Momentum, Zen, and Stats to match how you navigate right now.

s1.title: How do you start your day?
s1.a0: I clarify priorities and time blocks first
s1.a2: I take a calm moment to regain clarity
s1.a3: I check numbers or indicators first

s2.title: Something interrupts you — what do you do?
s2.a0: I reframe and plan how to resume
s2.a1: I pivot fast to the new urgency
s2.a2: I take a short pause to regain clarity
s2.a3: I log it and estimate impact (time, load)

s3.title: At the end of the day, what matters most?

s4.title: An important deadline is approaching
s4.a1: I speed up and cut the non-essential
s4.a2: I seek clarity before the final push
s4.a3: I lean on numbers and tracking

s5.title: When coordinating with others, you favor…

radar.empty: No intentions yet. Tap + to add one.

timeline.subtitle: Today’s rail — suggested slots follow your spectrum (high Momentum → deeper blocks).
timeline.dayRail: Where you are in the day (6am–10pm)
timeline.empty: Nothing to place on the rail yet. Add intentions from Radar.

stats.screenSubtitle: Observations from your co-pilot — gentle, not grades.
stats.clarityHint: A soft read on how your actual minutes compared to what you planned (completed focus only).
stats.noSessionsToday: No completed focus yet today. Close a capsule and this will fill in.
stats.spectrumHint: Minutes from completed sessions, weighted by each block’s spectrum tags.
stats.spectrumEmpty: Nothing to chart yet for today.
stats.historyHint: Completed sessions grouped by local day — your archive on device.
stats.historyEmpty: Your history will appear as you finish focus blocks.
stats.insightEmpty: When you complete a focus block, I’ll share a short reflection here — no hurry.
stats.insightLead: Today, more of your closed time leaned toward {{axis}} — a pattern worth noticing, not a verdict.
stats.insightClarity: Clarity sits around {{score}}% — how close today’s real minutes felt next to your estimates.
stats.insightShort: Even one or two short blocks still tell a gentle story.
stats.insightEnergyLow: Your energy gauge looks soft; small steps tomorrow are enough.
stats.insightEnergyOk: Energy looks steady enough for whatever you choose next.

debug.resetProfileHelp: Clears onboarding_complete and user_spectrum in AsyncStorage, then returns to the 5-situation onboarding.
debug.rebuildDbHelp: Drops SQLite tables then runs CREATE (localDb). Screens that read the DB refresh via event (e.g. Radar).

recharge.title: Recharge
recharge.subtitle: Pick a rhythm. We simulate a calm ad handoff, then a 30s coherence breath — your co-pilot gains energy.

flash.title: Flash
flash.desc: A quick reset — light touch, fast return.

breath.title: Breath
breath.desc: Cardiac coherence pace — smooth bubble, softer nervous system.

immersion.title: Immersion
immersion.desc: Deeper pause — more credit for your ally.

adSim.title: Dopamine pause
adSim.sub: Ethical slot — sponsor simulation. Next: heart coherence.

dopamine.title: Breathe with the bubble
dopamine.hint: Inhale as it rises, exhale as it falls — about 10s per wave.

done.title: Recharge complete
done.sub: Energy added for your co-pilot. Come back anytime.

ally.settingsLead: Shape how TellYouTo sounds to you — voice, tone, and languages.
ally.uiLangHint: Menus and labels in the app.
ally.aiLangHint: Language the co-pilot will prefer for reasoning and replies (can differ from the UI).

safeExternal.title: Leave TellYouTo?
safeExternal.message: You’re in your focus zone. Do you really want to open an external link?
